ideas.pitch: A self-hostable submission and scoring engine that provides transparent data lineage for every score adjustment, ensuring tamper-proof final results using a local event log.
ideas.title: RaptorPipeline Local Data Lineage & Judge Audit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core hackathon problem: building the platform the organizers will use, leveraging the data engineering patterns seen in winning data lineage projects.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first LLM semantic routing module embedded within the judging pipeline to auto-categorize and pre-score submissions against project specifications without external APIs.
ideas.title: DockerJudge AI Semantic Routing and Scoring Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact heavy workload judges face by automating rubric compliance checking using local vector search and routing techniques.

ideas.pitch: A visual workflow orchestration engine using BPMN state machines to manage the entire hackathon data pipeline from team registration to certificate generation via docker-compose.
ideas.title: BPMN Hackathon Lifecycle Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organizers struggle with manual process handoffs between registration, judging, and archiving; a robust state machine solves their daily operational nightmare.

ideas.pitch: A standalone zero-dependency containerized storage backend with automated fixture seeding that boots instantly via docker compose up to handle massive submission payloads locally.
ideas.title: Zero-Config Hackathon Fixture Seed & Archive Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the strict requirement that the platform must run locally with a single command and zero external cloud dependencies or accounts.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight operational dashboard and CLI tool that orchestrates local container lifecycles, real-time submission ingestion, and normalized scoring distribution for hackathon admins.
ideas.title: OS-Orchestrated Local Hackathon CLI & Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins by providing the ultimate developer-first operational control panel that judges can immediately spin up and test on their own machines.
